research_question: With no access to which B cues are initially wrong during anchor acquisition, does changed-sign detection preserve the two-step repair while saving replay events relative to unconditional replacement?

fixture.A_map: Rank A cues by SHA-256(seed|cue|A-map); first eight target 0, last eight target 1.
fixture.B_map: Rank B cues by SHA-256(seed|cue|B-map); first four target 0, last four target 1.
fixture.initial_wrong_B_cues: Rank B cues by SHA-256(namespace|initial_wrong|seed|cue) and invert the first four labels. This set is hidden from the anchor acquisition rule.
fixture.training_stream: Generate complete 16x8x2x2 A/B cue-action factorial (512 events), with global success from true XOR target. Sort by SHA-256(namespace|order|seed|original_index). No label or wrong-cue value enters the sorting key.
fixture.anchor_rule: In stream order retain and update from the first two events for each A cue, regardless of B cue, action, target or outcome; exactly 32 source-matched anchors. All later training events are observed but do not update A.
fixture.late_B_revision: After the 512-event stream, replace B local codes with one exact label per B cue. No ordinary A update follows.
fixture.test: Complete 16x8 A/B cue factorial, 128 predictions per seed; no test-time updates.

arms.prior_only: No replay; retain the 32 early local A updates.
arms.simple_tie_zero: For each old/revised sign change, one revised local update; predict 0 on a tie.
arms.simple_tie_one: Same one-step packets and updates as simple_tie_zero; predict 1 on a tie.
arms.selective_two_step: For each old/revised sign change, one magnitude-two packet and two revised local updates on the recorded branch.
arms.unconditional_two_step: One magnitude-two packet for every retained source, even when its sign is unchanged; two revised local updates on the recorded branch.
arms.sign_shuffle_two_step: Select changed sources, then invert each delivered revised sign.
arms.route_shuffle_two_step: Select changed sources, then deliver each revised packet to the opposite recorded branch.
